annotations.title: Camp Map Pass: what it adds and how to buy it

description: What the Camp Map Pass adds over the free map (offline maps, the full scouting list, work-week picks, the full hunting view, more for AI assistants), its prices (CA$55 a year or CA$5 a month), direct purchase links, and how the user gives the pass to an assistant. Also says whether the current request carries a valid pass. Covers offline use, more spots, work-week picks, hunting details and upgrading.
